title: Diplomatic spat between Tokyo and Beijing threatens Japan's already fragile economy
summary: Tensions spiraled on Nov. 8, when Takaichi said that a Chinese attempt to seize Taiwan by force would constitute a "survival-threatening situation" for Japan.

title: OPEC+ Set to Keep Oil Production Policy Despite Saudi-UAE Spat
